name: Boaz
overview: Boaz is prominently featured in Scripture as a key figure in the lineage of Jesus Christ, being the son of Salmon and the father of Obed, as recorded in Matthew 1:5 and Luke 3:32. His story begins in the time of the judges, during a famine, where he is identified as a relative of Elimelech and a landowner in Bethlehem (Ruth 1:1; 2:3). While some references associate Boaz with one of the brazen pillars of the temple, the biblical narrative primarily highlights his role in God's providential plan through his connection to Ruth, underscoring God's faithfulness in preserving the Messianic line.
